question: Where can I find a nature reserve located south of Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ within 190 kilometers?
sql: WITH source_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bayonne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P, source_poi AS S WHERE P.leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, S.geometry::geography, 190 * 1000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(S.geometry, P.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
